scene.label: Act 4, Scene 7
scene.title: SCENE VII. A camp at a short distance from Rome
scene.location: A camp at a short distance from Rome

lines.text: Do they still fly to th' Roman?
lines.plainText: Do they still fly to th' Roman

lines.text: I do not know what witchcraft's in him, but
lines.plainText: I do not know what witchcraft's in him but

lines.text: Your soldiers use him as the grace 'fore meat,
lines.plainText: Your soldiers use him as the grace 'fore meat

lines.text: Their talk at table, and their thanks at end;
lines.plainText: Their talk at table and their thanks at end

lines.text: And you are dark'ned in this action, sir,
lines.plainText: And you are dark'ned in this action sir

lines.text: Even by your own.
lines.plainText: Even by your own

lines.text: I cannot help it now,
lines.plainText: I cannot help it now

lines.text: Unless by using means I lame the foot
lines.plainText: Unless by using means I lame the foot

lines.text: Of our design. He bears himself more proudlier,
lines.plainText: Of our design He bears himself more proudlier

lines.text: Even to my person, than I thought he would
lines.plainText: Even to my person than I thought he would

lines.text: When first I did embrace him. Yet his nature
lines.plainText: When first I did embrace him Yet his nature

lines.text: In that's no changeling, and I must excuse
lines.plainText: In that's no changeling and I must excuse

lines.text: What cannot be amended.
lines.plainText: What cannot be amended

lines.text: Yet I wish, sir—
lines.plainText: Yet I wish sir

lines.text: I mean for your particular—you had not
lines.plainText: I mean for your particularyou had not

lines.text: Joined in commission with him, but either
lines.plainText: Joined in commission with him but either

lines.text: Had borne the action of yourself or else
lines.plainText: Had borne the action of yourself or else

lines.text: To him had left it solely.
lines.plainText: To him had left it solely

lines.text: I understand thee well, and be thou sure,
lines.plainText: I understand thee well and be thou sure

lines.text: When he shall come to his account, he knows not
lines.plainText: When he shall come to his account he knows not

lines.text: What I can urge against him, although it seems,
lines.plainText: What I can urge against him although it seems

lines.text: And so he thinks and is no less apparent
lines.plainText: And so he thinks and is no less apparent

lines.text: To th' vulgar eye, that he bears all things fairly,
lines.plainText: To th' vulgar eye that he bears all things fairly

lines.text: And shows good husbandry for the Volscian state,
lines.plainText: And shows good husbandry for the Volscian state

lines.text: Fights dragonlike, and does achieve as soon
lines.plainText: Fights dragonlike and does achieve as soon

lines.text: As draw his sword; yet he hath left undone
lines.plainText: As draw his sword yet he hath left undone

lines.text: That which shall break his neck or hazard mine
lines.plainText: That which shall break his neck or hazard mine

lines.text: Whene'er we come to our account.
lines.plainText: Whene'er we come to our account

lines.text: Sir, I beseech you, think you he'll carry Rome?
lines.plainText: Sir I beseech you think you he'll carry Rome

lines.text: All places yield to him ere he sits down,
lines.plainText: All places yield to him ere he sits down

lines.text: And the nobility of Rome are his;
lines.plainText: And the nobility of Rome are his

lines.text: The Senators and Patricians love him too.
lines.plainText: The Senators and Patricians love him too

lines.text: The Tribunes are no soldiers, and their people
lines.plainText: The Tribunes are no soldiers and their people

lines.text: Will be as rash in the repeal as hasty
lines.plainText: Will be as rash in the repeal as hasty

lines.text: To expel him thence. I think he'll be to Rome
lines.plainText: To expel him thence I think he'll be to Rome

lines.text: As is the osprey to the fish, who takes it
lines.plainText: As is the osprey to the fish who takes it

lines.text: By sovereignty of nature. First, he was
lines.plainText: By sovereignty of nature First he was

lines.text: A noble servant to them, but he could not
lines.plainText: A noble servant to them but he could not

lines.text: Carry his honours even. Whether 'twas pride,
lines.plainText: Carry his honours even Whether 'twas pride

lines.text: Which out of daily fortune ever taints
lines.plainText: Which out of daily fortune ever taints

lines.text: The happy man; whether defect of judgment,
lines.plainText: The happy man whether defect of judgment

lines.text: To fail in the disposing of those chances
lines.plainText: To fail in the disposing of those chances

lines.text: Which he was lord of; or whether nature,
lines.plainText: Which he was lord of or whether nature

lines.text: Not to be other than one thing, not moving
lines.plainText: Not to be other than one thing not moving

lines.text: From th' casque to th' cushion, but commanding peace
lines.plainText: From th' casque to th' cushion but commanding peace

lines.text: Even with the same austerity and garb
lines.plainText: Even with the same austerity and garb

lines.text: As he controlled the war; but one of these—
lines.plainText: As he controlled the war but one of these

lines.text: As he hath spices of them all—not all,
lines.plainText: As he hath spices of them allnot all

lines.text: For I dare so far free him—made him feared,
lines.plainText: For I dare so far free himmade him feared

lines.text: So hated, and so banished. But he has a merit
lines.plainText: So hated and so banished But he has a merit

lines.text: To choke it in the utt'rance. So our virtues
lines.plainText: To choke it in the utt'rance So our virtues

lines.text: Lie in th' interpretation of the time,
lines.plainText: Lie in th' interpretation of the time

lines.text: And power, unto itself most commendable,
lines.plainText: And power unto itself most commendable

lines.text: Hath not a tomb so evident as a chair
lines.plainText: Hath not a tomb so evident as a chair

lines.text: T' extol what it hath done.
lines.plainText: T' extol what it hath done

lines.text: One fire drives out one fire, one nail one nail;
lines.plainText: One fire drives out one fire one nail one nail

lines.text: Rights by rights falter; strengths by strengths do fail.
lines.plainText: Rights by rights falter strengths by strengths do fail

lines.text: Come, let's away. When, Caius, Rome is thine,
lines.plainText: Come let's away When Caius Rome is thine

lines.text: Thou art poor'st of all; then shortly art thou mine.
lines.plainText: Thou art poor'st of all then shortly art thou mine
